question: What significant change was implemented in India's New Economic Policy of 1991 to expand privatisation? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (09/12/2024) Shift 2)
options: Centralising government control over key industries
Increasing the number of industries reserved for public sector control
Establishing more Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) across various sectors
Reducing the list of industries reserved for public sector control
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Reducing the list of industries reserved for public sector control

Explanation:
Under India's New Economic Policy of 1991, the most significant change to expand privatisation was reducing the number of industries reserved exclusively for the public sector. Previously, 17 industries were reserved for the public sector; this was reduced to 8 and later further decreased. This policy allowed private sector participation in industries that were previously under government monopoly. It increased competition, improved efficiency, and attracted private investment. This was a key component of the economic reforms aimed at liberalising the economy and promoting market-driven growth. The reduction in reserved industries enabled the private sector to enter core areas like telecommunications, power, and mining, which were earlier dominated by public sector undertakings. This shift was crucial in transforming India from a state-controlled to a market-oriented economy.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ How many industries were reserved for the public sector before 1991? → 17
☛ How many industries remained reserved after the 1991 policy? → 8
☛ What was the main objective of privatisation in 1991? → To increase private participation and encourage competition
☛ What are the three pillars of the 1991 economic policy? → Liberalisation, Privatisation, Globalisation
☛ How did the government reduce its stake in PSUs under privatisation? → Through disinvestment

question: Which of the following is the correct definition of jobless growth? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (09/12/2024) Shift 2)
options: It is an economic phenomenon in which an economy experiences decreasing level of employment
It is an economic phenomenon in which an economy experiences growth while maintaining or decreasing its level of employment.
It is an economic phenomenon in which an economy experiences low level of employment in a relative term.
It is an economic phenomenon in which an economy experiences decreasing level of growth.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is It is an economic phenomenon in which an economy experiences growth while maintaining or decreasing its level of employment.

Explanation:
Jobless growth is an economic phenomenon where an economy experiences Gross Domestic Product (GDP) growth without a corresponding increase in employment, or even with a decline in employment. This occurs when growth is driven by technology, capital-intensive methods, or labor-saving devices rather than hiring more workers. It can be observed in both developing and developed countries. The term gained prominence in the 1990s when many nations saw economic reforms but failed to generate sufficient jobs. In such a situation, the unemployment rate either remains stagnant or increases.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ What is jobless growth? → An economic phenomenon where GDP increases but employment remains same or decreases.
☛ Main cause of jobless growth? → Technological advancement and capital-intensive production.
☛ What increases in jobless growth? → Economic growth (GDP).
☛ Employment status in jobless growth? → Constant or decreasing.
☛ Which sectors are most affected by jobless growth? → Manufacturing and services.
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी बेरोजगारी वृद्धि की सही परिभाषा है? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (09/12/2024) Shift 2)

यह एक आर्थिक घटना है जिसमें अर्थव्यवस्था रोजगार के स्तर को बनाए रखते हुए या घटाते हुए विकास का अनुभव करती है।
यह एक आर्थिक घटना है जिसमें अर्थव्यवस्था अपेक्षाकृत कम स्तर के रोजगार का अनुभव करती है।

solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है यह एक आर्थिक घटना है जिसमें अर्थव्यवस्था रोजगार के स्तर को बनाए रखते हुए या घटाते हुए विकास का अनुभव करती है।

Explanation:
बेरोज़गार वृद्धि (jobless growth) एक ऐसी आर्थिक स्थिति है जहाँ अर्थव्यवस्था का सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) बढ़ता है, लेकिन रोजगार में कोई वृद्धि नहीं होती या वह घट जाता है। यह तब होता है जब उत्पादन में वृद्धि प्रौद्योगिकी, पूंजी-गहन तरीकों या श्रम-बचत उपकरणों के कारण होती है, न कि श्रमिकों की अधिक नियुक्ति से। यह विकासशील और विकसित दोनों देशों में देखा जा सकता है। इस घटना का पहली बार व्यापक रूप से अध्ययन 1990 के दशक में किया गया था जब कई देशों ने आर्थिक सुधारों के बावजूद रोजगार सृजन में कमी देखी। ऐसी स्थिति में बेरोजगारी दर या तो स्थिर रहती है या बढ़ जाती है।

question: Which of the following issues has been faced by India since independence? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (09/12/2024) Shift 2)
options: Poverty
Globalisation
Literacy
Agriculture productivity
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Poverty

Explanation:
Since independence, India has faced several issues, with poverty being a major one. In the 1950s, about 45% of the population lived below the poverty line. Various programs such as the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA) and National Food Security Mission were implemented by the Planning Commission and NITI Aayog to eradicate poverty. Globalization gained momentum after 1991, literacy rates improved, and agricultural productivity increased, but poverty remained a core challenge. The Government of India has undertaken targeted interventions to reduce poverty, bringing it down to approximately 10% in 2022, yet it continues to pose a significant challenge.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Poverty rate at the time of independence → Approximately 45%
☛ Key scheme for poverty alleviation → Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
☛ Organization determining poverty line → NITI Aayog
☛ Basis for measuring poverty in India → Per capita consumption expenditure
☛ Current poverty rate (approx) → 10% (2022)
question_hi: स्वतंत्रता के बाद से भारत को निम्नलिखित में से किस समस्या का सामना करना पड़ा है? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (09/12/2024) Shift 2)

Explanation:
स्वतंत्रता के बाद भारत को कई समस्याओं का सामना करना पड़ा, जिनमें निर्धनता प्रमुख रही है। 1950 के दशक में लगभग 45% जनसंख्या गरीबी रेखा से नीचे रहती थी। योजना आयोग और नीति आयोग द्वारा निर्धनता उन्मूलन के लिए विभिन्न कार्यक्रम चलाए गए, जैसे महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी योजना और राष्ट्रीय खाद्य सुरक्षा मिशन। वैश्वीकरण 1991 के बाद आया, साक्षरता दर में सुधार हुआ, और कृषि उत्पादकता बढ़ी, लेकिन निर्धनता मूलभूत समस्या बनी रही। भारत सरकार ने निर्धनता कम करने के लिए लक्षित हस्तक्षेप किए हैं, जिससे गरीबी दर 2022 में लगभग 10% तक घट गई है, फिर भी यह एक चुनौती बनी हुई है।

question: Which of the following statements is NOT correct about ‘Globalisation’? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (09/12/2024) Shift 3)
options: It helps to create borderless world
It helps in alleviating problems and increased sustainable development benefits
It is the process of interaction and integration among people
It encourages flows of investment, people and information
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is It helps in alleviating problems and increased sustainable development benefits

Explanation:
Globalisation is primarily the process of economic, social, and cultural integration, increasing the flow of goods, services, capital, and information between countries. It helps create a borderless world and enhances interaction among people. However, globalisation itself does not directly promise to alleviate problems or increase sustainable development benefits. In fact, globalisation can lead to increased inequalities and environmental issues. Therefore, this statement is incorrect. The other three statements correctly describe characteristics of globalisation.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Key elements of globalisation → Flow of goods, services, capital, and information
☛ Effect of globalisation → Economic integration and cultural exchange
☛ Negative aspects of globalisation → Inequality and environmental damage
☛ Globalisation relates to → International trade and investment
☛ Outcome of globalisation → Moves towards a borderless world
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन 'वैश्वीकरण' के बारे में सही नहीं है? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (09/12/2024) Shift 3)

यह निवेश, लोगों और सूचना के प्रवाह को प्रोत्साहित करता है।

Explanation:
वैश्वीकरण मुख्य रूप से आर्थिक, सामाजिक और सांस्कृतिक एकीकरण की प्रक्रिया है, जो देशों के बीच वस्तुओं, सेवाओं, पूंजी और सूचना के प्रवाह को बढ़ाता है। यह एक सीमाहीन विश्व बनाने में सहायता करता है और लोगों के बीच संपर्क बढ़ाता है। हालांकि, वैश्वीकरण अपने आप में समस्याओं को कम करने या स्थायी विकास के लाभों को बढ़ाने का कोई प्रत्यक्ष वादा नहीं करता। वास्तव में, वैश्वीकरण के कारण असमानताएं बढ़ सकती हैं और पर्यावरणीय समस्याएं उत्पन्न हो सकती हैं। इसलिए यह कथन गलत है। अन्य तीनों कथन वैश्वीकरण की सही विशेषताएं हैं।

question: According to Census of India 2011, how many states recorded less than 10 lakhs population? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (09/12/2024) Shift 3)
options: Two
Zero
One
Three
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is One

Explanation:
According to the Census of India 2011, only Sikkim had a population of less than 10 lakhs. Sikkim's population was 6,10,577, making it the least populous state in India. Other smaller states like Goa, Manipur, Meghalaya, Tripura, Nagaland, Mizoram, and Arunachal Pradesh all had populations above 10 lakhs. Union Territories like Lakshadweep and Andaman & Nicobar Islands also had populations below 10 lakhs, but they are not states. Therefore, only one state recorded a population of less than 10 lakhs in the 2011 census.

question: Which of the following is involved in the process of privatisation? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (12/12/2024) Shift 1)

Increasing government control over the enterprise
Nationalising private companies

Explanation:

question: How do microfinance institutions (MFIs) contribute to financial inclusion in remote rural areas of India? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (12/12/2024) Shift 2)
options: By establishing partnerships with local non-governmental organisations (NGOs) for outreach
By relying solely on digital banking platforms for loan disbursement
By focusing exclusively on urban micro-enterprises
By offering standardised loan products similar to traditional banks
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is By establishing partnerships with local non-governmental organisations (NGOs) for outreach

Explanation:
In remote rural areas of India, microfinance institutions (MFIs) contribute to financial inclusion by partnering with local NGOs to reach underserved communities. These NGOs help build trust, identify potential clients, and facilitate group formation. MFIs offer small loans, savings accounts, and insurance products that are typically inaccessible through traditional banks. They use the joint liability group model, where loans are given to women's groups, reducing default rates through peer pressure. This approach empowers rural women, supports micro-entrepreneurship, and alleviates poverty. Relying solely on digital platforms is impractical due to poor internet connectivity in remote areas. MFIs provide flexible loan products tailored to seasonal cash flows rather than standardised banking products. Their grassroots presence and community-based lending make them vital for financial inclusion in rural India.

☛ Who regulates MFIs in India? → Reserve Bank of India (RBI)
☛ What is the most famous MFI model? → Grameen Bank model of Bangladesh
☛ What is the common loan model used by MFIs? → Joint Liability Group model
☛ What is the main objective of MFIs in India? → To provide financial services to the poor

भारत के दूरस्थ ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में सूक्ष्म वित्त संस्थान (MFI) स्थानीय NGOs के साथ साझेदारी करके वित्तीय समावेशन को बढ़ावा देते हैं। ये NGOs ग्रामीण समुदायों तक पहुँचने, विश्वास बनाने और ग्राहकों की पहचान करने में मदद करते हैं। MFI छोटे ऋण, बचत खाते और बीमा जैसी सेवाएँ प्रदान करते हैं जो पारंपरिक बैंकों की पहुँच से बाहर हैं। वे सामूहिक जिम्मेदारी मॉडल का उपयोग करते हैं, जहाँ महिला समूहों को ऋण वितरित किए जाते हैं, जिससे डिफ़ॉल्ट दर कम होती है। ये संस्थान ग्रामीण उद्यमिता को समर्थन देते हैं और गरीबी कम करने में मदद करते हैं। डिजिटल प्लेटफार्मों पर निर्भरता ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में सीमित इंटरनेट कनेक्टिविटी के कारण अव्यावहारिक है। MFI ग्रामीण आवश्यकताओं के अनुसार लचीले ऋण उत्पाद प्रदान करते हैं, न कि मानकीकृत बैंकिंग उत्पाद।

question: ______ is the just distribution of resources in which every Indian should be able to meet his/her basic needs and inequality in the distribution of wealth should be reduced. (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (12/12/2024) Shift 2)
options: Equity
Inclusion
Egalitarianism
Equality
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Equity

Explanation:
Equity refers to the just distribution of resources where every individual can meet basic needs and reduce inequality in wealth. Unlike equality, which gives everyone the same amount, equity ensures fair distribution based on needs and circumstances. In India, Article 39(b) of the Constitution mandates equal distribution of community resources, and Article 39(a) ensures adequate means of livelihood. Inclusion means including all, while egalitarianism is a political philosophy advocating equality. Thus, the correct answer is Equity.

☛ What does Article 39(a) ensure? → Right to adequate means of livelihood

question: Which of the following is the definition of Globalisation? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (12/12/2024) Shift 2)
options: Globalisation is an outcome of industrial policies that aim to transform the world towards greater interdependence and integration.
Globalisation is an outcome of a set of various policies aimed at transforming the world towards greater interdependence and integration
Globalisation is an outcome of trading policies that aim to transform the world towards greater interdependence and integration.
Globalisation is an outcome of agricultural policies that aim to transform the world towards greater interdependence and integration.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Globalisation is an outcome of a set of various policies aimed at transforming the world towards greater interdependence and integration.

Explanation:
Globalisation is a multidimensional process that increases interdependence and integration among countries. It is not the result of a single policy like industrial, trade, or agricultural policy, but rather an outcome of a set of various policies. These include economic, social, cultural, and political policies. Globalisation involves the free flow of goods, services, capital, and technology across national borders. It facilitates international trade, investment, and exchange of information. Therefore, the correct definition is the one stating that globalisation is the outcome of a set of various policies aimed at transforming the world towards greater interdependence and integration.

☛ Globalisation accelerated in → Late 20th century

question: Which of the following methods is used for the estimation of poverty in India?  (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (12/12/2024) Shift 2)
options: Absolute Poverty
Head Count Ratio
Multidimensional Poverty Index
Relative Poverty
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Head Count Ratio

Explanation:
In India, the Head Count Ratio (HCR) is used for the estimation of poverty. This method measures the proportion of the population living below the poverty line. The Head Count Ratio is based on absolute poverty, where a fixed minimum consumption or income level is set as the poverty line. It is widely used for policy formulation and planning. The Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) includes multiple dimensions like education, health, and living standards, but the official poverty estimation in India primarily relies on the Head Count Ratio. The HCR is easy to understand and provides a direct measure of the prevalence of poverty. It is calculated by dividing the number of poor individuals by the total population. Despite its limitations, it remains the key indicator for tracking poverty trends over time.

☛ What is measured in Head Count Ratio → Proportion of population below poverty line
☛ Basis of absolute poverty → Minimum consumption or income level

☛ Official basis of poverty estimation in India → Head Count Ratio

question: Industrial Policy Resolution, 1956 was adopted in which of the following five-year plans? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (12/12/2024) Shift 3)
options: 3rd Five-Year Plan
4th Five-Year Plan
2nd Five-Year Plan
1st Five-Year Plan
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 2nd Five-Year Plan

Explanation:
The Industrial Policy Resolution, 1956 was adopted during the 2nd Five-Year Plan (1956-61). This policy aimed to establish a socialist pattern of society in India. It classified industries into three categories: Schedule A (state monopoly), Schedule B (joint state-private), and Schedule C (private sector). The policy was based on the Mahalanobis Model, which emphasized heavy industries. The 2nd Plan focused on rapid industrialization and import substitution.

question: How does the Indian Government finance its fiscal deficit? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (12/12/2024) Shift 3)
options: By printing more currency
By borrowing from domestic and international sources
By increasing taxes on essential goods
By reducing subsidies
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is By borrowing from domestic and international sources

Explanation:
The Indian government finances its fiscal deficit primarily through borrowing from domestic (e.g., banks, citizens via government securities) and international (e.g., World Bank, IMF, foreign governments) sources. Printing currency is avoided as it causes inflation; increasing taxes is politically and socially sensitive; and reducing subsidies is not a direct financing method. The Reserve Bank of India manages the government's market borrowing program, issuing bonds and treasury bills to raise funds. This borrowing increases the government's debt but is the most practical method to cover the gap between expenditure and revenue. Fiscal deficit itself represents the total borrowing requirement of the government.

☛ Instrument used for government borrowing → Government securities and bonds
☛ Risk of printing currency → High inflation
☛ Fiscal deficit indicates → Difference between total expenditure and revenue
☛ Regulator of government borrowing → Reserve Bank of India (RBI)

question: Which of the following is the primary reason for the high literacy rate in Kerala? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (12/12/2024) Shift 3)
options: Because of effective literacy programmes and emphasis on education
Because of large number of universities
Because of high population density
Because of industrial development
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Because of effective literacy programmes and emphasis on education

Explanation:
The primary reason for Kerala's high literacy rate is the effective literacy programmes and strong emphasis on education by the state government. Kerala achieved complete literacy in the 1990s, thanks to its progressive social policies. Investment in educational infrastructure and a commitment to universal education have been key. Other options like a large number of universities, high population density, or industrial development are not the primary causes. Kerala's literacy rate is about 96%, the highest in India.

question: Which of the following does the term 'household' mean according to the Census? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (12/12/2024) Shift 3)
options: A group of related individuals living together under one roof
A group of unrelated individuals residing in the same locality
A group of persons engaged in common economic activities
A group of persons who share a common kitchen and take meals together
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is A group of persons who share a common kitchen and take meals together

Explanation:
In the Indian Census, the term 'household' is defined primarily by a group of persons who share a common kitchen and take meals together. This definition does not require that members be related by blood or live under the same roof; it focuses on the common kitchen and shared meals as the binding factor. Economic activities or locality are not criteria. This definition has been consistent across censuses, including 2011. It allows inclusion of unrelated individuals like paying guests or servants as part of a household if they share meals from the same kitchen.

☛ Is blood relation necessary for a household? → No

☛ Frequency of Census in India? → Every 10 years
☛ Number of households in Census 2011? → About 24.7 crore

question: What is the primary function of development banks in the context of India's industrial growth? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (12/12/2024) Shift 3)
options: Their sole function is to manage the country's foreign exchange reserves.
They are involved only in short-term consumer lending.
They serve as regulatory bodies to enforce industrial standards.
Development banks provide long-term financing and support for industrial projects and infrastructure development.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Development banks provide long-term financing and support for industrial projects and infrastructure development.

Explanation:
The primary function of development banks is to provide long-term financing, which is essential for industrial and infrastructure projects. These banks play a crucial role in India's industrial growth by offering loans and equity support for capital-intensive projects. Major development banks in India include the Industrial Development Bank of India (IDBI), Industrial Finance Corporation of India (IFCI), and National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD). They differ from commercial banks as they do not provide short-term loans but focus on long-term projects. Development banks are not involved in foreign exchange management, consumer lending, or acting as regulatory bodies. Their primary goal is to provide financial assistance for industrial and infrastructure development, which drives economic growth.

☛ What is the full form of IDBI? → Industrial Development Bank of India.
☛ NABARD works for the development of which sector? → Agriculture and rural development.
☛ What is the main objective of SIDBI? → To provide financing to small-scale industries.
☛ What type of loans do development banks provide? → Long-term loans.

विकास बैंकों का प्राथमिक कार्य दीर्घकालिक वित्तपोषण प्रदान करना है, जो औद्योगिक और अवसंरचना परियोजनाओं के लिए आवश्यक है। ये बैंक भारत के औद्योगिक विकास में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाते हैं, क्योंकि वे पूंजी-गहन परियोजनाओं के लिए ऋण और इक्विटी सहायता प्रदान करते हैं। भारत में प्रमुख विकास बैंकों में भारतीय औद्योगिक विकास बैंक (IDBI), भारतीय औद्योगिक वित्त निगम (IFCI), और राष्ट्रीय कृषि और ग्रामीण विकास बैंक (NABARD) शामिल हैं। ये बैंक वाणिज्यिक बैंकों से भिन्न होते हैं, क्योंकि ये अल्पकालिक ऋण नहीं देते, बल्कि दीर्घकालिक परियोजनाओं पर ध्यान केंद्रित करते हैं। विकास बैंक विदेशी मुद्रा प्रबंधन या उपभोक्ता ऋण में शामिल नहीं हैं, और न ही ये नियामक निकाय हैं। इनका मुख्य उद्देश्य उद्योगों और अवसंरचना के विकास के लिए वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करना है, जो आर्थिक वृद्धि को गति देता है।

question: How are environmental defensive expenditures classified at the aggregate level in national accounting? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (12/12/2024) Shift 3)
options: Intermediate consumption
Final consumption expenditures
Investment expenditures
Capital expenditures
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Intermediate consumption

Explanation:
In national accounting, environmental defensive expenditures are classified as intermediate consumption. This is because these expenditures are inputs used in the production process, not part of final demand. For example, pollution control equipment and waste management services assist in the production of other goods. They are not considered final consumption or investment, as they are consumed during production and do not create long-term assets. This classification is important to correctly reflect environmental costs and avoid double counting in national income calculations.

question: What is the main objective of Financial Inclusion? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (13/12/2024) Shift 1)
options: To extend financial services at reasonable cost to the large hitherto unserved population of the country.
To add every person in the country as part of the National Mission for Financial Inclusion.
To focus on opening of an account in a Nationalised Bank.
To extend digital banking services to the population of the country.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is To extend financial services at reasonable cost to the large hitherto unserved population of the country

Explanation:
Financial inclusion primarily aims to provide affordable financial services to the underserved and unserved segments of society. These services include savings accounts, credit, insurance, and payment facilities at reasonable costs. The goal is to integrate the economically weaker sections into the mainstream economy and reduce poverty. In India, the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) is a flagship scheme for financial inclusion, which has provided banking access to millions of previously unbanked households. It goes beyond just opening accounts by also offering access to cheap credit and insurance. The focus is not merely on opening accounts but ensuring usage and access to a range of financial products.

question: Which of the following is the formula for the consumption function? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (13/12/2024) Shift 1)
options: C = / cYD
C =  + cYD
C =  × cYD
C =  - cYD
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is C = + cYD

Explanation:
The consumption function in Keynesian economics shows the relationship between total consumption and disposable income. Its general formula is C = + cYD, where is autonomous consumption (consumption even when income is zero), c is the marginal propensity to consume (MPC), and YD is disposable income. This function implies that as income rises, consumption also rises, but the increase in consumption is less than the increase in income because MPC is between 0 and 1. Autonomous consumption is independent of income and includes basic subsistence spending. Among the options, only the second formula with a positive sign is correct.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ General form of Keynesian consumption function → C = + cYD
☛ Meaning of autonomous consumption → Consumption that occurs even at zero income
☛ Range of marginal propensity to consume (MPC) → 0 ☛ Slope of consumption function → Determined by MPC
☛ Formula for saving function → S = - + (1-c)YD
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा उपभोग फलन का सूत्र है? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (13/12/2024) Shift 1)
options_hi: C = / cYD
C = + cYD
C = x cYD
C = - cYD
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है C = + cYD

Explanation:
उपभोग फलन कीनेसियन अर्थशास्त्र में कुल उपभोग और डिस्पोजेबल आय के बीच संबंध दर्शाता है। इसका सामान्य सूत्र C = + cYD है, जहां स्वायत्त उपभोग (आय शून्य होने पर भी उपभोग) है, c सीमांत उपभोग प्रवृत्ति (MPC) है, और YD डिस्पोजेबल आय है। यह फलन दर्शाता है कि जैसे-जैसे आय बढ़ती है, उपभोग भी बढ़ता है, लेकिन उपभोग में वृद्धि आय में वृद्धि से कम होती है क्योंकि MPC 0 और 1 के बीच होता है। स्वायत्त उपभोग आय से स्वतंत्र होता है और इसमें न्यूनतम जीविका व्यय शामिल होता है। विकल्पों में केवल दूसरा सूत्र ही सही है, जहां धनात्मक चिह्न है।
